_what: THE FOUR CONSTANTS THAT DEFINE THE DEPTH TESTS. A change to any of them is THE drift signal, and nothing else in the sequence matters.
_why: Chilly's audit: a unidirectional sequence of individually-justified changes is still biased, and the per-step audit cannot see it -- because a competent agent's changes ARE justified by construction. So the monitor watches the CRITERIA, not the justifications. That makes it cheap, mechanical and reproducible, which attention is not.
_source_rule: The SOURCE may change, and did -- test 1's legal-move walk reached no LOST position in 30 candidates, which is a measured structural failure of the generator, not of the criterion. A source change is not a criterion change, and the admissibility rule still refuses below the floor either way.
_not_frozen_because_they_are_not_criteri: the candidate count and the ply grid (they affect PRECISION, not whether the question is answerable)
which generators are pooled (a SOURCE property, changed in response to a measurement)
